skills.name: explain
skills.description: Explain a Specle change's purpose, requirements, approach, and current lifecycle state.
skills.usage: Use with a named change when a user wants to understand its intent, implementation direction, kind, status, and next action without changing it.

skills.name: specle
skills.description: Describe the installed Specle workflow and skill inventory.
skills.usage: Use when a user asks what Specle does, which skills are available, what a skill does, or where to begin.

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: Establish or refresh a repository's project guidance overlay.
skills.usage: Use when project guidance is missing or incomplete; inventory it, ask one question at a time, then write the completed overlay.

skills.name: changes
skills.description: List pending and active Specle changes with next stages.
skills.usage: Use to inventory unfinished, selected, unselected, or dependent changes and report their recorded next steps; it never changes lifecycle state.

skills.name: status
skills.description: Report the current Specle change and local worktree state.
skills.usage: Use to orient current work: show the selected change, its lifecycle next action, and a compact Git worktree summary without changing anything.

skills.name: analyse
skills.description: Analyse codebases for guidance drift, technical debt, and risk.
skills.usage: Use when a developer asks to understand a codebase, audit risks or technical debt, or refresh project guidance from implementation evidence.

skills.name: spike
skills.description: Investigate a question within a time-box, without implementation.
skills.usage: Use before committing to a solution when a bounded investigation is needed; produce findings and recommendations, not production changes.

skills.name: activate
skills.description: Explicitly select and commence an unselected normal change.
skills.usage: Use with a named unselected normal change to select it in this worktree and begin its planning lifecycle.

skills.name: define
skills.description: Create evidence-led, unselected normal change definitions under `.specle/changes/`.
skills.usage: Use when scoping potential normal work: investigate evidence, resolve material uncertainty, and define the change without activating it.

skills.name: design
skills.description: Design a normal change's technical implementation.
skills.usage: Use after normal requirements exist, especially for M/L/XL or uncertain work, and before task planning.

skills.name: estimate
skills.description: Estimate Specle work complexity and planning depth.
skills.usage: Use before implementation to size an active change and decide whether design is warranted; it is advisory and performs no implementation.

skills.name: revise
skills.description: Revise changes and plans after accepted feedback.
skills.usage: Use when accepted feedback changes requirements, design, or tasks; do not use it for an implementation-only defect.

skills.name: tasks
skills.description: Generate task plans from normal changes and designs.
skills.usage: Use after normal requirements and any necessary design exist to create or reconcile an ordered TDD task plan; do not infer completed work from a diff.

skills.name: build
skills.description: Implement active Specle tasks with TDD.
skills.usage: Use when the active normal change, or an explicitly named committed normal target, is planned or building with incomplete tasks; execute tasks in order and stop at verify when they are complete.

skills.name: resolve
skills.description: Dispatch accepted review decisions to follow-up workflows.
skills.usage: Use only after triage has recorded decisions for all current findings; route accepted work without implementing it directly.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Review verified implementations for quality and policy compliance.
skills.usage: Use only after verification passes to assess implementation quality, guidance compliance, coverage, and security; it records approval or findings but does not implement fixes.

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Consolidate review findings into prioritised decisions.
skills.usage: Use after local review or with supplied external feedback to deduplicate findings and record decisions without implementing fixes.

skills.name: verify
skills.description: Verify implementations against changes and quality gates.
skills.usage: Use after implementation tasks are complete and before review; check every requirement and documented gate against current code and tests.

skills.name: cancel
skills.description: Archive one explicitly named active change as cancelled without claiming delivery.
skills.usage: Use with a stable active change name to end it after required dependency and in-flight cleanup decisions.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Deliver approved Specle work according to project policy.
skills.usage: Use after local review approves a change, bugfix, or refactor to prepare or perform its configured commit, push, and pull-request delivery actions.

skills.name: complete
skills.description: Finalise or resume archival delivery for a committed Specle change.
skills.usage: Use after committed delivery to archive it on its existing delivery path, request final merge where applicable, or resume the missing finalisation phase.

skills.name: track
skills.description: Link Specle work to configured external sources and destinations.
skills.usage: Use for explicitly named external imports, source checks, or authorised destination publishing; never write to a source.

skills.name: bugfix
skills.description: Fix bounded defects with abbreviated test-first work.
skills.usage: Use for a clear, bounded defect that needs a reproduction and regression test; use change when the work introduces new behaviour or broader scope.

skills.name: prepare
skills.description: Prepare non-active bugfixes or refactors for later work.
skills.usage: Use to create an explicitly named unselected repair or behaviour-preserving restructure without implementation changes.

skills.name: refactor
skills.description: Restructure code without changing observable behaviour.
skills.usage: Use for structural cleanup protected by documented invariants and tests; use change when new behaviour is needed.

skills.name: summary
skills.description: Summarise completed Specle work for people.
skills.usage: Use only after work is complete to create a human-facing report and copy-ready update; it does not publish externally.
